title: Wayfare Pass Desk Tool Card — Moving Up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly
content:
# Moving up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

## Rule

A move up to the Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly plan takes effect on the day it is made: a new one-month period of Plus Monthly starts that day and the Plus Monthly upgrade charge is collected for it as a plan change charge.

The Plus Monthly upgrade charge is worked out only after the billing period in force carries a collected membership fee.

Put the other way round: while the billing period in force carries no collected membership fee, the Plus Monthly upgrade charge is not worked out.

| Before the move | After the move |
|---|---|
| The member's current plan and current period | Plan Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly; a new one-month period starting on the day of the move |
| — | A plan change charge, in the amount of the Plus Monthly upgrade charge, booked on the membership ledger for the new period |

## Capability of the tool

`upgrade_pass_to_plus_monthly_9f7c0895` moves the member's own Wayfare Pass membership up to the Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly plan today, with payment of the plan change charge. One call changes the plan to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, starts a new one-month billing period on today's date (its last day follows the plan's period-end rule), clears any student verification date, books a membership fee charge with reason `plan_change_proration` for the new period, and adds the charge to the membership's net fees paid.

## How it is invoked

The move is the member's own act. The agent unlocks the tool with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pass_membership_id` | The Wayfare Pass membership reference number being moved up, as returned by the membership lookup. | Identifier string. |
| `proration_charge` | The plan change charge collected now, in USD. | A non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; never empty. |

## Return

On success the tool returns a dictionary with `pass_event_id` (reference number of the plan change fee charge), `pass_membership_id` (the membership changed), `variant_name` (the plan now held, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly), `current_period_start` and `current_period_end` (first and last day of the new period, YYYY-MM-DD) and `proration_charge` (the amount collected, USD with 2 decimal places). The member then sees the Plus Monthly plan, the new period dates and the charge on the membership ledger.

## Hypothetical illustration

A move made on 21 June returns a `current_period_start` of 21 June and a `current_period_end` of 20 July, the day before the same day-of-month one month later.
